visual_brief.subject: NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform
verified_context: OpenShell runs agent workloads inside isolated sandboxes with externally enforced filesystem, process, network, credential, and policy controls.
NVIDIA Sentry adds an optional out-of-band monitoring and enforcement layer on BlueField-4 DPUs outside the host where the agent runs.
The architectural lesson is to place critical enforcement somewhere the agent workload cannot rewrite or bypass.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: The important security boundary sits outside the agent workload, so the workload can act without being able to rewrite the rules that contain it.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A small abstract working chamber sits inside multiple external containment layers, with controlled passages crossing those boundaries and a physically separate observation structure outside the protected core.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant but overly segmented; the triptych weakened the single-focal-idea rule and reduced thumbnail clarity.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. Strong containment metaphor with no robot, text, labels, logos, UI, or decorative security iconography. The isolated chamber and external layers remain legible at card size.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant but less story-specific; the split composition and mechanical secondary scene made the architecture feel less focused.
